subject: Cadet Drafter, Roads and Highways, Gold Coast (JR119314), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: SMEC's Roads and Highways team on the Gold Coast supports the design and delivery of road and transport infrastructure projects across Queensland.
letter.subject: Cadet Drafter, Roads and Highways, Gold Coast (JR119314)
letter.greeting: Hello SMEC Roads and Highways team,
paragraphs: I saw your Cadet Drafter advert for the Roads and Highways team on the Gold Coast. Road design was a core part of my Advanced Diploma, so I am applying.

I finished my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, wrote site reports and kept records, which fits the drawing checks and document control in your advert.

Your advert asks for someone currently enrolled in an Advanced Diploma or Associate Degree; I have completed mine rather than still studying, and I would welcome the chance to start at cadet level and learn your Autodesk workflow. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to the Gold Coast. I have a White Card, a driver's licence and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.

checklist: Marc to decide whether to apply although the advert asks for current enrolment (his Advanced Diploma is completed) and whether he accepts a part time role on the Gold Coast
Check Gmail again for any SMEC or Surbana Jurong receipt, then open the Workday link and confirm it is still open (closes 31 Oct 2026)
Apply through Workday Apply Now only (SMEC asks that resumes are not sent to employees) with the master resume and the saved cover letter PDF
Answer Workday questions from facts only; do not claim current enrolment or TMR road experience
Note the receipt date in /workspace/job-finds (tracker recording is paused)
notes: Found on SMEC's Workday careers board by open web search (employers rotation). Held: current enrolment requirement unresolved.
